notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 2 questions​

[*] Due to the game's heavy reliance on luck, there was a significant variance in players' clear times. (Playtime ranging from 1 hour 30 minutes to 4 hours)​To address this issue, we've adjusted the game so that the longer you play, the more frequently desired options appear, thereby reducing the difficulty. (Difficulty decreases with longer playtime)​

[*] The drop button has been removed.​

[*] Now, upon clearing the game, summoned enemies in the room will disappear.​

[*] Now, after clearing the game, the "Pressing the button occasionally summons zombies" will no longer trigger. (Really, this time!)​

[*] Fixed the bug where the zombie horde would still appear even after being illuminated.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where all magazines disappeared when reloading while holding more than two guns.
 
[*] Fixed an issue where reloading and shooting became impossible when interacting with other objects during reloading.

[*] Fixed an issue where some text fonts appeared broken.

[*] Item name change: Key 01 -> Key

[*] Adjusted the Blue Ending so that the scene automatically transitions after 18 seconds if no final choice is made.

[*] Moved the Red Ending text slightly earlier to reduce confusion.

[*] Fixed an issue where questions could still be asked after a system error message.

[*] Removed fall damage from the last ladder area.
[/list]
Red or Blue has received a lot of love. Thank you so much for playing and enjoying the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Fixes
[list]
[*] Most debuffs are removed during the ending sequence.

[*] Fixed a bug where random weapon drops would occasionally spawn food.

[*] Reduced the movement speed of the abomination slightly.
[/list]

Known but Unresolved Bugs
[list]
[*] Attempting to shoot while climbing a ladder or riding a zipline may cause the weapon to stop reloading afterward.

[*] Occasionally, items disappear into the floor.

[*] When exiting the game (especially if the exit button is not used), the process does not terminate properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Red or Blue Official Release! (Patch 1.0)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Red or Blue has been officially released!

[*] 22 new questions have been added.

[*] Four types of endings and an expert difficulty level have been added.

[*] Four premium items have been added.

[*] When obtaining a random item, there is a low chance to receive one of the premium items, and additional choices are provided accordingly.

[*] 14 new challenges have been added.

[*] Some bugs have been fixed, and sound effects have been added.
[/list]
